The graph above shows the curve $y={2}^{x}+c.$ Determine the value of $c$ and find the equation of the curve.
worked_solution:
The horizontal asymptote of $y={2}^{x}$ is $y=0.$ The vertical translation $y={2}^{x}+c$ shifts the asymptote to $y=c.$

In the graph above, the horizontal asymptote is $y=-3.$ Therefore, $c=-3.$
